He did say that the Dual Pressure Switch Assembly part is not working and they need to replace it, then he tried to close back the 2 panels of the furnace ( he mix they up ) but he didn’t know how so they were keep failing, I had to tell him how. Then he spoke with his office to send me an estimate for replacement, that was $750 parts and labor. After the technician left I opened up the panels and I saw that the red wire is disconnected I was very upset and I called to his office and they apologized and offered me a discount and the new bill now is $450 I said ok, but they didn’t have the part so they had to order it and received it within 3 days( remember it’s very called days out there and I have a 7 years old child in the house). Told them I’m canceling them and I called to a different company I had to pay diagnostic all over again but I was fine with it because I needed it to be fixed. The other technician opened the furnace panels he saw immediately that one red wire was disconnected he explained me that this is the wire that provide power to the system and if you see closely a white wire is connected with the Same spot with the blue wire which is WRONG it should connected with the other white wire. The technician runs the system diagnose it and nothing was wrong with my furnace at all!!!
The Rain City Pro services wanted to return the diagnostic fee that they charged me but I know why?! not because they feel bad about it, because they were hoping that I will get my money back and won’t write this report. Imagine how many times they did it to other people? Disconnect their system to show that is broken. I could give them 0 stars I would but the app doesn’t allow it.

pros.bio: Hi there! I'm a professional DJ and producer that's been DJing since I was a young teen, starting in nightclubs and now do private events including school dances, lavish corporate events, private parties and weddings. I’d love to help you make your event a success! I bring my own professional sound system and have elegant set ups. I can provide wireless mics, lasers, full light shows with intelligent live lighting control. Unlike most mobile DJs, I provide a full immersive audio visual experience with synchronized lights and special effects. I'm not your typical 'mobile DJ' playing off a laptop with unsynchronized lights from Amazon! In terms of music, I spin everything from top 40 (commercial songs you'd hear on the radio) to EDM (dance music) and everything in between. I'm also a producer, so you'll be jamming to my own exclusive remixes, too! Everything is mixed live and songs flow seamlessly from one to another as you would hear at an Las Vegas nightclub. All my music is high resolution and was purchased legally. I belong to two large national record pools and stay up to date with new music weekly. I have an unsurpassed passion for music and this shows in my work. I have tons of video footage from previous nightclub, and private parties, just ask me for a sample of a recent DJ set. I only take on a limited number of events each month, so I have time to dedicate to each one. Aside for nightclub events, the majority of my work is weddings, corporate events, and private events. Thanks and look forward to working with you!

reviews.author: Nana K.
reviews.body:
From first contact to completion of the project, Attic Projects-Everett was very professional and easy to work with.  I found them through Thumbtack while searching for a company to get rid of the rodents that I had heard in my attic.

Although my initial thought was just to have the rodents removed, all three companies I contacted confirmed that the rodents had broken through the old wire mesh covering the attic air vents a while ago and had made a mess of the attic space with their droppings and urine contaminating and compromising the existing insulation.

Attic Projects-Everett’s initial appointment to assess the situation was very thorough.  Mason Huston, the estimator/project manager went up into the space and took pictures of the existing situation (to the cramped nether ends of the attic) and then walked me through his problem assessment and proposal.

Although not the least expensive, Attic Projects-Everett’s proposal made the most sense to me, and they worked with me to make the cost more competitive and to offer financing options.  They proposed a three step process:

Phase I:
·         Remove the existing insulation
·         Clean and sanitize the attic space
·         Inspect electrical and plumbing for any damage
·         Rodent proof the attic by covering all external air vents or openings with wire mesh and/or foam
·         Apply foam insulation around light fixtures and between sheets of drywall to minimize air exchange between the attic and the inside of the house
·         Set traps to make sure no rodents are still in the attic

Quality Control:
·         Inspect for and remedy any remaining potential rodent proofing issues including smaller holes around piping
·         Verify that no more rodents are inside the attic

Phase II:
·         Install the new insulation (at least 2 days after no detectable rodent activity inside the attic)

Throughout this process, Attic Projects-Everett has been great about their communications, their timeliness, and their efficiency in getting things done. All their people were great to interact with. Mason was always available by text and made sure everything was moving forward. Amy was great with the financial paperwork and scheduling. Cardenas was very thoughtful and thorough with his quality control inspections and additional rodent proofing measures. And finally, the removal and installation team (Ramon  and his assistant) were friendly, efficient, and tidy in the process of converting my attic space from a hazmat site back to usable storage space.

I highly recommend Attic Projects-Everett!

reviews.author: F C.
reviews.body: I entrusted a pro hired to do the job as agreed to. When I met them at the house, I asked them if they needed anything else and they said no. So I left them to take care of the cleaning I hired them to do. The house is a vacant ~ 1300 sqft 3bd/2bath which the majority of the work for the space I had already taken care of myself. The bedrooms/stairs/living area make up most of the square footage of the house. The bedrooms/stairs did not require vacuuming as the carpet is new and was already vacuumed, and the living room area did not need mopping as that was already taken care of myself prior to hiring them. The team messaged they were done after several hours. Given the time they were there and the small space being cleaned, I expected it to be spotless. Pretty much the entire kitchen area that required cleaning they did not clean (the countertops I had already cleaned myself). The kitchen baseboards/floor/inside the cabinets were still dirty. It was agreed to the inside of the cabinets would be cleaned but they were not. The pantry cabinet was still dirty and I was being told it was cleaned while they’re standing next to me and I’m looking at the dirt. The kitchen sink still looks about the same as I had left it before they arrived with perhaps a slight improvement. There was no detailed cleaning of the kitchen sink and still has mildew build up in the corners and staining on the basin. There was no detailed cleaning of the stove. The carbon residue on the stovetop was not cleaned or looks any better than before. The kitchen window blind was partly cleaned (if that), the rest was not. The first bathroom sink still has build up under the rim. Most of the work for the first bathroom was already cleaned by myself and I hired a Thumbtack pro to take care of the details. When I addressed the pantry cabinet that was not cleaned, and they're telling me it is, they eventually cleaned part of it still leaving the dirt on the floor and baseboard. Apparently they count the inside of the cabinet the same as the living room floor and think this part of the cabinet doesn’t require cleaning, same with the kitchen floor. They said to me “you said that this is new flooring (and doesn’t need to be cleaned).” No. I stated in writing the carpet is new and was already vacuumed and the living area is already mopped. The kitchen floor is very obviously not new hardwood floor and it was not cleaned at all though it was agreed that it would be. I had said that the living room area doesn’t need mopping but it’s being interpreted as nothing needs to be swept either anywhere. The pantry cabinet was left with the dirt on the floor and baseboards, same with the kitchen. The entry way as well, the dirt areas was missed by the baseboards and there were still cobwebs left on the walls. Second upstairs bedroom there are cobwebs that were not dusted away. I took care of the cobwebs in the primary bedroom on my own the other day. I ultimately had to stop asking them to finish cleaning and stopped showing them the areas they missed (like pretty much the entire kitchen). Because they didn’t care enough to do the job. I paid them the entire amount as per the original agreement despite the work not being complete. It’s clear we are not on the same page regarding the expectations of what was to be cleaned vs. what was actually done and what they consider clean. How they didn’t manage to even clean the kitchen in what ended being from 3:30pm to nearly 8:30pm is beyond me. I wasn’t there supervising them so I don’t know what they were doing with the time. The team lead did not do a walk through and did not check everything was done. It was embarrassing to have to address what was missed. I hate micromanaging people and expect people to do the job they're hired to do without having me supervise them. Their response to my concerns was met with indifference and uninterested in the job being completed and I paid them over $400 for incomplete work (see After Photos).

reviews.author: Brendan H.
reviews.body: Overall a good experience, and I would work with Jose again! I live in Seattle and I had a few small landscaping projects - removing a storage area on the side of my home and using the leftover gate/wood to build a small gated fence; extending driveway pavers in my front yard; leveling and extending my backyard patio pavers; shortening my front step; and removing a bush in my backyard and replacing with sod. Jose was available quickly to provide a free on-site quote, and offered a reasonable price to complete the work. It took about 3 weeks to schedule the project after agreeing on the scope of the project and price, and the crew was able to finish the work in a timely manner. I did have an initial issue with the height of the backyard patio pavers, which left a large step up from the grassy area in my backyard, but after I pointed it out the crew they were very understanding and able to redo the work to make the pavers level with the grass. Also there were a few other minor issues - a mix-up on the position of the gate for the fence, and the sod that was laid down doesn't appear to match the existing grass in my backyard. But overall I am happy with how everything came out. I would just recommend that the crew verify the work with the client prior to starting, and if issues or questions arise, raising them early on with the client.

reviews.body: I have to say that when I started the process of looking for a mover and getting quotes I was nervous. Horror stories I read of movers not showing up or going way over their estimates were swirling in my mind as I researched. I received four quotes from moving companies. I did my homework, checked each company on the UTC website and read a lot of reviews. People Movers responded to my e-mail quickly and then followed up with a phone call. They asked very specific questions that helped them give me the most accurate estimate that they could. At the end of the day their quote was not only the lowest but they were the most responsive and electronic friendly. I confirmed my booking via phone and received an e-mail confirmation shortly afterward. I was told I would get a confirmation call the day before the move. Guess what? I absolutely got that call and they answered any last minute concerns I had. Jamel and Oleg showed up early the next morning and went right to work after a short conversation with me about what was being moved. They hauled butt up and down 4 flights of stairs of my old place in record time! I've never seen two people work harder or faster to get things done. They wrapped things up and met me at the new place and unloaded just as quickly. I ended up saving money because they finished faster than what was estimated. I was so pleased that I gave them each a good tip. They deserved it and I only wished I had more to give them that day. They never hung around or moved slowly. I never felt like I needed to watch my stuff. I am truly impressed. At the end they went over the invoice with me and asked me to sign. I would definitely recommend these guys.

reviews.author: Ashfaq S.
reviews.body:
I trained with Kevin for about 1.5 years from September 2022 to March of 2024. Over this time Kevin taught me a lot about weight training. I started from very basic exercises on machines and gradually went up to more advanced exercises with free weights. Over this time, I became much stronger and better fit overall. Kevin also gave me the initial guidance on what to eat so that I can replenish well after the workouts. Over time, I became independent and was able to do on my own the same routines that Kevin set up for me.

I suffered for years with chronic upper back, neck, shoulder area pains. The workout routines helped me get stronger gradually and reduce the pain significantly to bring it to a manageable level. It took a very long time, but I got there eventually with guidance from Kevin.

For any new / prospective clients, it is important to remember that working out is only half the work to get stronger or get in better physical shape. The other part is eating well and doing it consistently. That is the hardest part. Without being consistent with food and workout routines, it is near impossible to achieve good results.

reviews.body:
AC Inc. Roofing left the job incomplete so any stars are me being generous. Damage in the pics attached

They were contracted to repair a leaky skylight for $850. When they eventually arrived (after initially missing the schedule we set) I was told a “proper” fix was going to cost $1955. This was a significant difference so I asked them to estimate the same work on all four of my skylights. I was told $3744. OK, clearly some price gouging when you can do them for $936 each but you want $1955 for one. 
That said, I accepted the new price for all four without fighting and decided to hold them to quality. 

The repair tech hammered hard on my roof for 4 days. Naturally, this knocked the interior drywall around the skylight onto our furniture which I cleaned every day. Not a small mess by any stretch but I didn’t complain. When the exterior work was finished I naturally expected them to fix the new damage they caused. I was told this was out of scope. For anyone who has PM experience this is laughable. The scope didn’t exist when we made the contract so it would have never been included. It’s an issue they caused. When explained this, they agreed and brought in someone to drywall and texture. Great. This painful but Im happy if it’s being fixed. To everyone’s surprise the interior tech told us he wouldn’t paint. I have the matching paint so this is seriously a small step to finish the repair. At that point, the owner Nick Bennett attempted to gaslight me with accusations and straight up lies. 

This is where they lost my business and my respect. I paid the invoice in full and will never, ever work with them again. You will regret it too. Stay away!

reviews.body: OUTSTANDING. Not only did they come out and do the job well they did it on my very high, slippery roof when others passed (and I don't blame them). Oh, and he did it IN THE RAIN. Nick was extremely courteous but was very communicative. True pros. HIGHLY recommend.

ACN Roofing came in at one of the lower prices, great reviews, and contracted to get the chimney from the roof line up at the same time. All while saving me thousands. Fabrici was great to deal with and very communicative along the way. I knew going in I wanted the 58 year sheeting replaced and he had a great rate per sheet than others which saved even more. He had a team of 4 rebuild my 17sq roof in a couple days and the quality of work was great. They took the time to beef up the large sagging overhangs with added supports and caulked all the joints. Used tarps all around the house during the job cleaned up all the areas after. Cleaned the gutters and pressure washed all the gutters faces to look new again. I have already recommended them to several friends.

reviews.author: Jie L.
reviews.body:
Impressive Work!

Our deck got destroyed by the Bomb Cyclone few weeks ago and we were desperately to have it replace. To be honest, we had more than 3 contractors came in and gave an estimate, the reason we chose Overall Constructions - we were impressed by Brian’s detail estimate and fare price. He went above and beyond of detailing everything in the estimate (not knowing whether he would win the bid). He is very knowledgeable and professional. After we chose his team, he came in the 2nd day to start working on the removal of the old deck.

During the past one and a half week, I received daily updates with pictures of the job progress and transparent communications via text. He ensures to provide several updates through out the day and when the estimate project to be finished.

Our old deck was make by some super skinny (4x4) posts. With this condition of the old deck, we were rarely go out the deck as it posted a risk of being on the 2nd and 3rd floor deck. Brian replaced the deck with three 6x6 posts on the lower and two 6x6 on the 3rd floor. With this design, our deck not only very sturdy, we would also spend more time on the deck than we ever before.

For less than 2 weeks, we got our brand new deck with real nice looking Trex. The quality and the design of the deck is amazing. We just spent great time with our family during Christmas on the deck and we were so happy as everyone is complimenting how nice the deck is built.

We would love to hire Brian and his team again to work on our  home remodeling project. With what he just completed (the replacement of our deck), he won the trust of us. As customers, we always want trustworthy people to do the right job, and Brian did it. The work he did is rarely find nowadays! Great work Brian! We would love to work with you again!

I knew it was time to live and pursue the thing that's always brought me so much joy vs never pursuing it at all. Ever since, I've pored all my heart into build my craft and launching Always Celebrating Photography. My work consists of wedding, event, family, maternity and individual portrait photography. I love collaborating with a few different genres of photography. This has allowed me to advance my skills at a rapid pace and apply those skills across genres in my own unique way. It's not only my mission to provide incredible photos for you to cherish forever, but it's also my mission to help you feel as comfortable and relaxed as possible during a photo session with me. I make sure to understand my clients vision, preference and ideas, so that on game day; you know I've got you covered and we can have an incredibly session! I LOVEEEEE celebrating life's special moments, no matter how big or small. Life and love of all kinds, is always worth celebrating; and I look forward to celebrating, you!

pros.bio: CAPTURING YOUR LOVE IN A TIMELESS, VIBRANT, AND GENUINE WAY. I discovered my passion for film photography in high school and pursued my bachelor’s degree in Indiana. I got my start as a second shooter in 2016 with weddings that had upwards of 400 guests. The experience solidified my love for capturing the magic of weddings, and it also led me to my passion for more intimate celebrations. As a result, I made the decision to specialize in documenting the beauty and authenticity of smaller weddings, and I love it. I have a passion for both film and digital photography, and I still use the 35mm camera my mom passed down to me that she has in college. After many years of using it solely for personal projects, I have finally started incorporating film into many of my sessions. Film gives a timeless, unfiltered feel that focuses on savoring the moments as they unfold. In the spring of 2018, I officially made the move to the Pacific Northwest and now call Seattle home. I married the love of my life, Joel, at our own intimate wedding. I have an adventurous yet easy-going personality, and I believe that the key to capturing your special day is to truly connect with you and your partner. I prioritize authenticity above all else, and my approach to photography is to adapt and flow with the natural rhythm of your wedding day
